Hi Maria —

We were on for our hands-on POC kickoff at 15:00 ET today but I see the seat was empty from our side. I hope everything is OK on your end. We have a short ops checklist that we walk through during the first 30–45 minutes (prompt review, routing options, and a quick KV-prefill load run) to make sure the runner is healthy before the full load.

If today no longer works, can you tell me: 1) a couple of 60–90 minute windows in the next 72 hours (we've found evening blocks work better for east-coast teams), and 2) whether you want us to run the low-latency routing or the high-throughput routing first?

I’ve attached a light runbook and the routing checklist so you can scan before we restart. If you'd prefer an async handoff + recorded walkthrough we can do that as well.

Thanks — I’ll hold potential evening slots (ET) while I hear back: 20:00–21:30, 21:30–23:00 tonight, or 18:00–19:30 tomorrow.

— Rishi

Rishi / Soojin —

19:00–20:30 ET tomorrow is fine on my side. Notes / ops checklist:
- Plan = 15 min prompt & prompt-set review, 25–30 min routing toggles (HT first), 20 min short concurrent KV-prefill to validate throughput, then open for questions.
- We should enable prefix caching for the first KV run to avoid warmup spikes.
- Suggest setting batch cap to 64 and token cap to 512 for the initial run, then drop to 32 for latency triage.
- Bring Canary fallback in routing policy in case we see degraded throughput.

I'll prepare a short doc we can paste into the chat during the session. Want me to own the load-run and leave you to handle prompt changes, Rishi?

— Marissa
